1.explanation: This reproducer combines three core features: fixedHeader (to lock the header), resizable (to allow width adjustments), and column filters (to trigger the dropdown). We set maxBodyHeight so the table body scrolls, and implement onResizeChange to update column widths. Clicking the filter icon on the first column header now reproduces the rendering glitch described (header misalignment and dropdown misplacement).
1.bug_scenario: When using the Next.js Table component with both fixedHeader and resizable columns enabled, clicking the column filter icon causes the header area to render incorrectly—cells shift or blank space appears, and the filter dropdown panel is misaligned relative to the header row.
